items.b: Write down when it hits: the time, the place, the feeling. Most cravings follow a pattern.
Add friction. Delete the app, move the vape to another room, log out after every use.
When the urge comes, wait 10 minutes. Cravings often peak and fade on their own.
Give your hands and brain something else: a walk, cold water, 10 push-ups.
One slip is −5, not zero. Seeing the trend keeps you from starting over.

chart.title: A slip is a dip, not a reset.
chart.body: Keep tracking. The trend matters more than one bad day.
